statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 12 is in the low band and remains below the block threshold.
recommendation: The closing hour is proceeding two-sided. NQ printed a 29,678.50 session high, retraced about 97 points, and has recovered only part of that move to 29,606.25, leaving the high unreclaimed; ES and SMH sit below their own highs and VIX has firmed off its session low. That is functioning mean reversion rather than persistent extension, so the assessment stays low in the band at Tail 12 while Stress holds at 49 on a very narrow advance, firm crude and a hawkish Fed backdrop. The mapped policy state is EA_ON. The single mapped danger window is 14:00-15:30 UTC on Aug 28 around the Fed chair's Jackson Hole keynote and the final Michigan sentiment reading, where a staged repricing is the specific structure that can deny retracement. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain unaffected by this assessment.
headline: NQ holds 29,606.25 into the close, about 72 points under the 29,678.50 high after a completed retracement; breadth stays narrow at 156 of 503 S&P advancers and Tail eases to 12
body: Nasdaq-100 E-mini futures trade at 29,606.25, up 316.75 points or 1.08%, in the final hour of the U.S. cash session. The session range is 29,401.75-29,678.50 against a 29,499.50 open, and a second reading from an independent quote source shows 29,599.25 at the same minute, so the level is well corroborated. The structural point is that the session high has not been reclaimed. The marginal high near 29,678 was rejected, price retraced roughly 97 points, the pullback held, and only part of it has been recovered. ES trades 7,732.50, up 0.55%, some 23 points under its own 7,755.50 high, and SMH is 569.00, up 2.38%, about 3.77 under its 572.77 high. VIX is 14.57, down 4.20%, having firmed from a 14.42 session low. Every one of those cross-checks points to a completed, orderly retracement rather than repeated extension after failed pullbacks. The advance itself remains exceptionally narrow. The Nasdaq composite is up about 1.3% on an 8.3% move in Nvidia after its results, alongside large gains in Salesforce, CrowdStrike and Okta, while only 156 of 503 S&P 500 members are higher and 23 of 30 Dow members are lower; the Dow is up about 0.1-0.3% and the Russell 2000 about 0.4%. A two-stock index advance is more reversible than a broad one, which argues against a persistent index-level one-way path even while the headline gain is large. Cross-assets are consistent rather than aligned into a single amplifier. The 10-year yield is 4.68% and the 2-year 4.24%, up 2.2 and 1.6 basis points, which is not the sort of yield extension that overwhelms equity mean reversion. WTI is $83.77, up about 1.9%, and Brent $89.94, up about 2.4%, firm on the continuing Strait of Hormuz disruption that has run since late February; that is a persistent Stress input, not a new discontinuity today. Today's U.S. data was labour-market strong and already absorbed, with initial claims at 203K against a 210K consensus and continuing claims at 1,778K. The live macro backdrop is hawkish. The Kansas City Fed president said on the eve of the symposium that inflation is too hot and that policy is accommodative, pointing to a possible move at the September meeting. Equities have so far absorbed that without a directional break, which is why it registers in Stress at 49 rather than in Tail. Confidence is 88 on corroborated current futures levels, verified volatility, yields, crude, breadth detail and a checked seven-day calendar. The shared Finviz context file was collected at 13:07 UTC and is outside its freshness window, so this assessment rests on independently verified sources only. The one mapped danger window remains 14:00-15:30 UTC on Aug 28 for the Jackson Hole keynote and the final Michigan sentiment reading.

lookbackSummary: The window runs from 19:00 UTC on Aug 26 to 18:00 UTC on Aug 27 and covers the Nvidia release and its full digestion into a technology-led advance. It opens calm and mixed at Tail 11 with Stress 61 as positioning built into the report. The 20:00 UTC release hour is the only non-green hour in the window, at WATCH with Tail 21 and Stress 66. Futures reopened at 22:00 UTC on the beat and raised guidance, and the assessment stepped down through 18, 16, 13 and 12 in event/whipsaw mode as the gap held without extending. From 03:00 UTC the regime returned to mixed and Tail sat at 10-11 through the Asian and European hours, with Stress easing from 50 to the mid-40s. The U.S. cash open at 13:00 UTC lifted Tail to 14 and Stress to 54 for one hour before both eased again. The single trend-up hour is 17:00 UTC at Tail 14, when NQ cleared the thrice-rejected 29,660 shelf and held within ten points of the high; that structure resolved into a retracement and 18:00 UTC returned to mixed at Tail 11. Three hours, 21:00 UTC on Aug 26 and 00:00 and 09:00 UTC on Aug 27, have no published assessment and are marked unavailable. The window contains no hour of sustained mean-reversion failure.
outlookSummary: The horizon runs from 19:00 UTC today to 18:00 UTC on Aug 28 and contains a closing hour, an empty overnight and one genuine catalyst cluster. With the session high unreclaimed and the retracement holding, conditional Tail holds at 12 through the power hour and the 20:00 UTC cash close. The 21:00 UTC maintenance break is the structural low of the horizon at 9, and a 10-11 overnight floor holds through the Asian hours in normal mode. European trade lifts the conditional path gently into mixed at 11-12 from 06:00 UTC, and 12-14 through the morning as month-end and Friday positioning build. The cluster is concentrated: 13:00 UTC carries the U.S. cash open and the Chicago PMI at Tail 16, then 14:00 and 15:00 UTC carry the Fed chair's Jackson Hole keynote and the final Michigan sentiment reading at conditional Tail 22 and 21, the only two slots mapping to WATCH and the exact span of the mapped danger window. The path then decays through 17, 15 and 14 into the weekly close on the assumption the keynote is absorbed without a persistent one-way leg. Those elevated slots reflect a credible staged-repricing mechanism, not an assertion that any future structure has been observed.
